messages:
Maya Patel: Hey design team — need a small asset pack for the Inference Economics webinar next Tue (recorded live). High priority. Details below.

Maya Patel: Deliverables:
- Hero diagram (3 variants): "Cost vs Latency" visual, simplified stack, output quality callouts
- Benchmark chart: latency (ms) vs cost ($/1M tokens) with 3 model families and error bars
- Slide template (16:9) + title + comparison slide
- Social microtiles: 4 sizes (twitter, linkedin, ig story, thumbnail)
- Localization: EN, DE, FR + two CTA copy options
- Brand compliance checklist + export-ready SVG/logos

Maya Patel: Timeline: First drafts by EOD Friday. Final by Monday noon PST.

Carl Nguyen: Can we get the raw data for the benchmark chart? Need csv and source notes.

Maya Patel: Yes — s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/latency_cost_2026.csv (headers: model, family, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, cost_per_1M_tokens, seq_len)

Zoe Alvarez: Figma file/frames please? Any preferred art direction? more literal graphs or stylized?

Maya Patel: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/inference-bench-kit — Use clean, production aesthetic. Stylized graph is fine but keep axes readable and accessible colors.

Alex Kim: Slide specs?

Maya Patel: Slide deck specs:
```
Aspect: 16:9 (1920x1080)
Title font: Inter (700)
Body font: Inter/Source Sans 400
Color accents: #0B5FFF (primary), #00C2A8 (accent), #0F1724 (dark)
Export: SVG for charts + PNG @2x for hero
```

DesignBot: Auto-check: Figma file permissions set to 'anyone with link can view'. Layer naming guideline: component/section/variant applied.

Lena (contractor): I can take hero + social tiles. Will follow naming convention — confirm naming.

Maya Patel: Naming --> benchmark_webinar/20260318_<asset>_v01.png (use YYYYMMDD of final export). E.g. benchmark_webinar/20260318_hero_variantA_v01.png

Carl Nguyen: Also add a short alt text for each social tile (for accessibility). I'll provide copy.

Zoe Alvarez: Noted. I'll mock up two graph styles (literal vs minimal) and a hero diagram variant that explains caching/batching visually.

Lena (contractor): ETA mockups by Thu EOD, final exports Monday AM. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Awesome — please drop Figma frames and export links in this thread when ready. Tag me @maya if you unblock.

DesignBot: Uploaded: /components/benchmark-kit (frames: hero_v1, hero_v2, graph_literal, graph_minimal, slide_master). Timestamp 1767205320

Alex Kim: Thanks team — will sync with comms for webinar landing copy once visuals are stable.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone! :rocket:
